entries.description: **Ship the four subcommands** against the existing `docs/modules.yaml` contract — read the shape `moduleAuthoring.ts` writes today and match it; this is a port, and a format change here would strand every repo that already has a manifest.

**Make the dangerous paths refuse.** `delete` and `rename` must refuse a module with a **running session**, and must route any `session-state.json` mutation through the sanctioned writer rather than touching the file. This is the invariant the set exists to restore.

**Rollback on partial failure.** A create that scaffolds a directory and then fails to append the manifest entry must leave neither behind. Ship a falsifier that injects the failure and asserts nothing is stranded — `L-112-1`: a gate that only ever passes proves nothing.
**Required portion of the full test suite.**
Registered session 1 of Set 122 (github-copilot / claude-opus-5, high).

Shipped ai_router/modules.py: create/rename/delete/assign-sets against the unchanged docs/modules.yaml contract (format-preserving splices, parse-after-write guards, ported normalization).

rename/delete refuse on a running session (incl. legacy file-presence inference); every session-state.json mutation routes through session_lifecycle.cancel_session_set, asserted behaviorally with a planted direct write as the falsifier.

_Transaction records every effect and undoes all of them; four injected-failure falsifiers (create/rename/assign-sets rollback, delete stays declared). Mutation-checked: disabling rollback fails 3 of them.
